title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open The bitcoin price fell to near $57,500 Wednesday as the Nasdaq sank 4% at the open on a deepening tech selloff, hot core PCE inflation and new U.S. tariff proposals. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
